description: Shows which EU member state services in VIES are currently available. Use it when a check returned 'unavailable' to see whether the national service is down.

country_code.description: Optional two-letter country code, e.g. DE. Greece is EL.

with_receipt.description: Optional, default false. Set true only when the user asks for a signed receipt of this check for their files.

name: vies_status
title: Show VIES availability
